issues.claim: V11 §3.25.11 gives each weather kind `hours` — "the hours of the view's day a spell may start in, read only under `light: 'time'` (§2.9), so fog and mist come on cool mornings" (`mist` and `fog` 4–11, `shimmer` 10–18) — but its timeline rule reads "At a week the kinds whose band holds it are live, each at its `perHour` × the largest factor of the sites …; with R their sum, the clear time after a spell (and from the map's opening) is exponential with mean 3 600 ÷ R s, the next kind is k with chance perHour_k ÷ R". `hours` enters neither R nor the kind's chance, so when a gap ends at a view hour outside the drawn kind's hours (fog drawn at 14:00 under `light: 'time'`) the spell "may" not start and nothing says whether it is dropped, deferred to the next admitted hour or redrawn; EI-V11-EDGE-6 covers only "a `light` other than `'time'`". The base end is verify-determinism-r2t's VDC2-01 (§6.1 *The weather stream*: liveness including the kinds' `hours`, the gap spent at the live rate); V11's own rule must say the same (R2-05).
issues.required_change: In V11 §3.25.11's *The columns* bullet replace "At a week the kinds whose band holds it are live, each at its `perHour` × the largest factor of the sites that apply (below); with R their sum, the clear time after a spell (and from the map's opening) is exponential with mean 3 600 ÷ R s, the next kind is k with chance perHour_k ÷ R" with "At a moment the kinds whose band holds the view's week and — under `light: 'time'` — whose `hours` hold the view's hour are live, each at its `perHour` × the largest factor of the sites that apply (below); with R their sum, the clear time after a spell (and from the map's opening) is spent at that live rate (§6.1: a unit exponential spent as the integral of R ÷ 3 600 over view time, none spent while R is 0), and the next kind is k with chance perHour_k ÷ R at the moment the gap ends". In *The kinds*' head, "`hours` the hours of the view's day a spell may start in" → "`hours` the hours of the view's day in which the kind is live". EI-V11-EDGE-6 adds the case "a kind whose `hours` exclude the view's hour" with the outcome "not live then: it adds nothing to R and is never drawn at that hour", and T-V11-45 (v) adds that fixture.
